title: Whether or Where? Tail Calibration Signals Finite-Budget Reward Hacking in Best-of-N Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.34375v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Best-of-N (BoN) inference returns the candidate with the highest proxy reward, so a larger $N$ tests the proxy's extreme tail more than its average ranking quality. We show that the exact BoN value is a Beta-weighted integral of conditional true reward over within-prompt score quantiles. It follows that BoN depends on scores only through their ranks. It also follows that BoN can decline only if the calibration curve in the tail turns downward, and the budget where the decline appears depends on where that turn lies. Under a bounded additive model, the error tail sets the limit: Gaussian errors keep improving, Laplace errors reach a plateau, and heavy-tailed errors return to the prior mean. When error variance is largest at low true reward, even Gaussian noise can push BoN below random selection. Synthetic phase maps agree with this taxonomy. On real candidate pools spanning several verifiable domains, base policies, and learned reward

translated_title: 是否与何处？尾部校准预示Best-of-N选择中的有限预算奖励欺骗
translated_abstract: Best-of-N（BoN）推断返回代理奖励最高的候选，因此更大的N更多考验的是代理奖励的极端尾部，而非其平均排序质量。我们证明，BoN的精确值是条件真实奖励在提示内分数分位数上的Beta加权积分。由此可知，BoN仅通过分数的秩（排序）依赖于分数；由此还可推知，只有当尾部的校准曲线向下转折时，BoN才会下降，且下降出现的预算规模取决于该转折点的位置。在有界加性误差模型下，误差尾部决定了极限：高斯误差下BoN持续提升，拉普拉斯误差下达到平台，重尾误差下则回落至先验均值。当误差方差在低真实奖励处最大时，即使是高斯噪声也能使BoN低于随机选择。合成实验的相图与这一分类完全一致。在涵盖多个可验证领域、基础策略与学习型奖励模型的真实候选池上……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 本文证明Best-of-N的精确值只依赖奖励分数的秩，其是否以及在多大预算下发生性能下降（奖励欺骗）完全由奖励误差的尾部校准决定——高斯误差持续提升、拉普拉斯误差趋于平台、重尾误差回落至先验均值，因此尾部校准曲线的转折点即可预示有限预算下的奖励欺骗。
en_tdlr: The exact Best-of-N value depends on scores only through their ranks, and whether and at what finite budget reward hacking occurs is dictated by the error tail: Gaussian errors keep improving, Laplace errors plateau, and heavy-tailed errors regress to the prior mean.
